description: Check text contrast against the WCAG AA threshold (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text); the AAA verdict is shown only when you pass level: "AAA". Either pass a `foreground` / `background` color pair, or pass `url` + `selector` to read the element's own text color, background (composited from the nearest painted ancestors), font size and weight from the live page; explicit colors win over the page. A gradient or image background is reported as an error, never a guessed ratio. When it fails, suggests BRAND-aligned replacements — extracts the actual brand palette from the `url` page using our scanner (CSS vars + most-used colors), or use a provided `brandColors` array. No `url` and no `brandColors` = ratio + pass/fail only.

background.description: Background color (hex or rgb). Optional with url + selector.

brandColors.description: Pre-supplied brand palette. Skips URL extraction if provided.

fontSize.description: Font size in px (default 16, or the element's computed size with url + selector)

foreground.description: Foreground color (hex or rgb). Optional with url + selector.

isBold.description: Whether text is bold (default false, or the element's computed weight with url + selector)

level.description: Conformance level to judge. Default "AA". "AAA" adds the enhanced-contrast (1.4.6) verdict and AAA palette suggestions.

selector.description: CSS selector of the text element on `url` (e.g. the `selector` from a scan_page issue)

url.description: Live page: with `selector`, the colors are read from that element; on a failing pair, the brand palette is extracted from it (uses our scanner — CSS vars + dominant colors).

name: check_color_contrast
title: Check color contrast
